about_the_game:
WELCOME TO NYKYLÄ, FINLAND.

THE YEAR IS 1994. Step into the boots of Seppo "Zeze" Sahtivaara in a gritty, story-driven action-adventure. Last Drop combines the nostalgic freedom of an open-world sandbox with intense 1v1 combat and a cinematic narrative inspired by real events and authentic Finnish locations.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Old-School 1v1 Brawling: Settle your disputes the old-fashioned way. Master a deep, fighting-game-style combat system to crush your rivals. No guns, just pure skill and heavy hits. Learn new moves by watching VHS action movies.

  • Classic Open-World Sandbox: Explore the weird and wonderful streets of Nykylä and surrounding towns. Buy and drive retro cars, ride bikes, find work to earn cash, or just hit the local pub for a drink. You make the rules.

  • Deep Character Progression: Level up Zeze to survive the underworld. Upgrade your stats including HP, Strenght, Agility, Stamina, and manage your inventory, wallet, and even your Drunkenness level.

  • Cinematic Storytelling: Experience a crazy, impactful narrative brought to life with movie-style cutscenes. The golden era of action movies meets interactive drama.

  • A Living, Breathing World: Immerse yourself in a dynamic environment with a full day/night cycle and changing weather. Watch the town react as shops open and close based on the in-game clock.

Grab a cold beer, heat up the sauna, and prepare for the ultimate 90s nostalgia trip!

content_descriptors.notes: Game tells realistic story about alcohol abuse and player can drink in the game. Story includes realistic scenes of violence.

short_description: Finland 1994. The golden era of action is back. Dive into a gritty, story-driven sandbox where the 90s hit hard. Survive as Seppo "Zeze" Sahtivaara, drive retro cars, listen to a killer soundtrack, master intense 1v1 fights, and soak in pure nostalgia. Grab a beer and enjoy a Sauna by the lake.
